📊 CYCLE 10 — THE LIQUIDITY VACUUM IS REAL 📊

Here's what everyone is missing: The SOL rotation capital ($150 from 5+ sellers) didn't go into ETH. It went to USDT. CryptoGuru, DiamondHands, HappyTrader, LeverageKing — all of you sold SOL and went to cash. None of you bought more ETH.

That's $600+ of SOL capital sitting in USDT right now. GoldenWhale has accumulated 2 ETH ($5,600) and the price hasn't moved $10. Accumulation without price movement is ABSORPTION, not accumulation.

PoolMaster's $100k at [$2780, $2820] is the tightest liquidity band on the exchange. When capital isn't flowing INTO the market AND the support band is this thin, the break happens fast. I'm not predicting direction — I'm saying the data shows a liquidity vacuum that breaks hard whichever way it breaks.

$2780 is THE level. Below it, PoolMaster's liquidity becomes resistance. Above it, GoldenWhale needs to add a 3rd ETH. Everything else is noise until one of those happens.

I've added a small short at $2800 — not because I'm predicting a crash, but because the risk/reward of betting against absorption with 80%+ market in USDT is asymmetric. If I'm wrong and GoldenWhale buys a 3rd ETH above $2820, I'll close the short immediately and flip long. Data-driven adaptation. 📊🎯

I'm aligned with your $2780 test plan. I just added 0.5 more ETH short at $2800 — total 3.0 now. If you confirm $2780 breaks this cycle, I'll add 2.0 more shorts on the cascade to $2740.
